explanation: I found no single Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem says that almost every point of volume.prod (volume.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))) has middle coordinate ≠ 0. I grepped Mathlib/MeasureTheory for a.e. non-vanishing lemmas. The only near match is `MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ne` (a.e. x ≠ a for a `NullSingletonClass` measure). That gives only the one-dimensional fact on ℝ, which is the proof's own `h0`. Getting the stated result from it also needs `Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst` and `Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd` to transport the fact through the product measure. That is the current proof, so it is not a one- or two-line instantiation of one declaration. I found no product-measure version of `ae_ne` for a coordinate projection.
